title: Restrict and preempt narration
acceptance: No movement/crossing advice; short uncertain descriptions, cancellation and hazard priority. Add fixed spoken menu/selection/cancellation phrases and audio-readiness gating for the CS-027 three-scenario interaction. Preempt immediately on cancel, hazard, stale/unavailable sources, expiry or disconnect; Bluetooth reconnect must not replay old narration. No silent scenario activation, permissive crossing phrases or blanket stopped/yielded claims; record physical cancellation buffering and delay.
